Article 368 – Amendment of Constitution
1st Amendment – 1951
42nd Amendment – 1976 (Fundamental Duties)
44th Amendment – 1978 (Right to Property removed)
86th Amendment – 2002 (Right to Education)
42nd Amendment is known as the Mini Constitution
42nd Amendment is known as the Mini Constitution

rows: Fundamental Duties; Known as Mini Constitution

items: Article 368 is repeatedly asked in exams as the article providing authority for Constitutional Amendments.
The 42nd Amendment (1976) is frequently tested for introducing Fundamental Duties and being termed the 'Mini Constitution'.
The 44th Amendment (1978) is notable for removing the Right to Property from the list of Fundamental Rights.
The 86th Amendment (2002) is a high-frequency question regarding the Right to Education.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 368 deals with the Amendment of the Constitution.
The 42nd Amendment (1976) introduced Fundamental Duties and is recognized as the Mini Constitution.
The 44th Amendment (1978) removed the Right to Property.
The 86th Amendment (2002) introduced the Right to Education.
